title: AtlaSlope Identity R2
h1: Clean and colourful, rooted in wine and land.
lines: Round 1 read as political or too modern. These four take colour and type from wine's own traditions.
Each concept shows the same four screens: logo, home, field guide entry, map.
Every map is real data: IGN terrain, IGME geology, MAPA boundaries. Every photo is a credited Rioja vineyard.
